title: HyperRepair: Recovering Forgotten General Capabilities of Fine-Tuned Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning improves a language model's performance in a target domain but can weaken its general capabilities. Existing methods often face a trade-off between general capabilities and domain specialization, making it difficult to preserve both. We introduce HyperRepair, a framework for recovering general capabilities while retaining domain specialization at only inference cost. To make recovery generalizable across models sharing a pretrained backbone, HyperRepair learns a hypernetwork from repairs trained on source models. The hypernetwork uses activation fingerprints that summarize changes from the pretrained backbone to generate a tailored Repairing Side Net (RSN), whose prompt-conditioned gate applies corrections selectively. This enables recovery on models from unseen adaptation domains without target-domain examples or additional optimization. translated_title: HyperRepair：恢复微调语言模型被遗忘的通用能力
translated_abstract: 微调可以提升语言模型在目标领域的性能，但可能削弱其通用能力。现有方法通常面临通用能力与领域专业化之间的权衡，难以同时保留两者。我们提出了HyperRepair，这是一个仅在推理成本下恢复通用能力、同时保留领域专业化的框架。为了使恢复过程能够泛化到共享同一预训练主干的不同模型上，HyperRepair从在源模型上训练的修复方案中学习一个超网络。该超网络使用概括了从预训练主干到微调后模型变化的激活指纹，生成定制的修复侧网络（RSN），其基于提示条件化的门控机制选择性地应用修正。这使得模型无需目标领域样本或额外优化，即可在来自未见过的适应领域的模型上实现能力恢复。我们在两个模型家族、12个LoRA适应数据集和15个通用能力上评估了HyperRepair。
tldr: HyperRepair提出了一种基于超网络的方法，通过利用激活指纹为共享预训练主干的模型生成定制的修复侧网络，在仅增加推理成本的前提下恢复微调语言模型被遗忘的通用能力，同时保留其领域专业化，且无需目标领域样本或额外优化。
en_tdlr: HyperRepair is a hypernetwork-based framework that uses activation fingerprints to generate tailored Repairing Side Nets for models sharing a pretrained backbone, recovering forgotten general capabilities of fine-tuned language models at only inference cost while retaining domain specialization, without requiring target-domain examples or additional optimization.
